task.prompt: Create the module that README.md describes.

checks.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {slugify} from './src/slugify.js'; const cases = [['Hello, World!', 'hello-world'], ['  Trim  Me  ', 'trim-me'], ['a--b', 'a-b'], ['Node 22 Rocks', 'node-22-rocks']]; for (const [input, want] of cases) { const got = slugify(input); if (got !== want) { console.error(JSON.stringify(input) + ' gave ' + JSON.stringify(got) + ', wanted ' + JSON.stringify(want)); process.exit(1); } }"
